references.text: The same measurements are used for the curtains of the tabernacle itself, showing the consistent design in the construction of the sanctuary.
Parallel text describing the actual execution of the instructions given in Exodus 26:8, with identical dimensions for the goat-hair curtains.
Basic principle that the tabernacle was to be built exactly according to the pattern shown by God to Moses, explaining the precise measurements.
Preceding verses introducing the goat-hair curtains for which verse 8 gives the measurements.
Reference to the tabernacle curtains that the Gershonites were responsible for carrying during the wilderness journey.
